steal the show: With her amazing voice, the young singer is sure to steal the show from the famous stars at tonight's concert.
憑著驚人的歌聲，那位年輕歌手一定會在今晚的演唱會上從大明星們那裡搶盡風頭。
steal a glance: During the test, Tom tried to steal a glance at his classmate's answers, but the teacher saw him.
考試時，湯姆想偷瞄同學的答案，但被老師看到了。
steal one's heart: The cute little puppy at the animal shelter will steal your heart the moment it wags its tail.
動物收容所裡那隻可愛的小狗一搖尾巴，就會偷走你的芳心。
steal the headlines: The young athlete's new world record is likely to steal the headlines in tomorrow's newspapers.
那位年輕運動員的新世界紀錄很可能會搶占明天報紙的頭條。
steal a march on: By selling its new phone a month early, the company hoped to steal a march on its competitors.
藉由提早一個月推出新手機，那家公司希望比競爭對手搶先一步。
steal the limelight: She wore a simple dress because she didn't want to steal the limelight from the bride at the wedding.
她穿了一件簡單的洋裝，因為她不想在婚禮上搶新娘的鋒頭。
steal a base: The fast runner tried to steal a base while the pitcher was not looking at him.
那名飛毛腿趁投手沒在看他時試圖盜壘。
steam ahead: Despite the strong wind and heavy rain, the ship continued to steam ahead toward the small island.
儘管風強雨大，那艘船仍繼續全速前進，駛向那座小島。
let off steam: After the final exams, the students went to the park to let off steam by running and shouting.
期末考後，學生們到公園跑跑跳跳、大喊大叫來發洩一下。
run out of steam: After playing for two hours, the tired players began to run out of steam in the last ten minutes.
打了兩個小時後，疲憊的球員們在最後十分鐘開始後繼無力。
steam vegetables: Instead of frying them in oil, my mother likes to steam vegetables to keep them healthy and fresh.
我媽媽不用油炸，而是喜歡蒸蔬菜，讓它們保持健康和新鮮。
steam open a letter: In the old movie, the spy used hot water to steam open a letter without anyone noticing.
在那部老電影裡，間諜用熱水的蒸氣拆信，沒有任何人發現。
under one's own steam: Although he hurt his leg in the race, he walked back to the hotel under his own steam.
雖然他在比賽中傷了腿，他還是靠自己走回飯店。
steer the conversation: When her aunt asked about her grades, Amy tried to steer the conversation toward her new hobby.
當阿姨問起她的成績時，艾咪試圖把話題引導到她的新嗜好上。
steer clear of: You should steer clear of strangers online who promise to give you free money or gifts.
你應該避開網路上那些承諾送你免費金錢或禮物的陌生人。
steer the country: The new president promised to steer the country safely through the difficult economic crisis.
新總統承諾會領導國家安全度過艱難的經濟危機。
steer a course: In the dark and stormy night, the captain had to steer a course between the dangerous rocks.
在漆黑的暴風雨夜裡，船長必須在危險的礁石之間掌舵航向。
steer someone toward: My science teacher noticed my love of animals and tried to steer me toward a career as a vet.
我的自然老師注意到我喜愛動物，便試著引導我走向獸醫這條職業道路。
steer the economy: The central bank must carefully steer the economy toward steady growth and avoid rising prices.
中央銀行必須小心地引導經濟走向穩定成長，並避免物價上漲。
stem the tide: The city hired more police officers to stem the tide of rising crime in the downtown area.
市政府聘請了更多警察，以遏止市中心犯罪日益增加的潮流。
stem from: Many of his health problems stem from a lack of sleep and too much time on his phone.
他的許多健康問題源於睡眠不足和花太多時間在手機上。
stem the flow: The government made new rules to stem the flow of fake news on social media.
政府制定新規定，以阻止假新聞在社群媒體上流動傳播。
stem the losses: The company closed several of its stores to stem the losses it had suffered over the past year.
那家公司關閉了好幾家門市，為過去一年來的虧損止血。
stem the spread: Washing your hands often can help stem the spread of the flu virus in crowded classrooms.
經常洗手可以幫助遏止流感病毒在擁擠教室裡的蔓延。
step down: The coach decided to step down after his team lost ten games in a row this season.
這一季球隊連輸十場比賽後，教練決定下台。
step up efforts: The city plans to step up efforts to clean the beaches before the summer vacation begins.
市政府計畫在暑假開始前加緊努力清理海灘。
step in: When the two boys began to fight in the hallway, a teacher had to step in and stop them.
當兩個男孩在走廊上開始打架時，一位老師不得不介入阻止他們。
step aside: The old manager agreed to step aside so that a younger person could lead the team.
那位年長的經理同意讓位，好讓年輕人來帶領團隊。
step out of line: The teacher warned that any student who steps out of line during the field trip will be sent home.
老師警告說，校外教學期間任何越軌的學生都會被送回家。
step on someone's toes: As a new member of the team, I tried hard not to step on anyone's toes during my first week.
身為團隊的新成員，我在第一週努力不冒犯任何人。
step up to the plate: When our class leader got sick, Amy decided to step up to the plate and organize the whole event.
當我們的班長生病時，艾咪決定挺身而出，籌辦整個活動。
step into someone's shoes: After the manager retires next month, no one is sure who can step into her shoes and lead the team.
經理下個月退休後，沒有人確定誰能接替她來帶領團隊。
